target_customer: Developers and teams building LLM applications and agents that need automated evaluation
problem: Teams spend a lot of time manually reviewing traces to find agent failures; Atla offers an LLM judge that finds and explains errors and suggests fixes.
business_model: Usage-based API for evaluator models plus a developer platform; open-source Selene models

founders.name: Maurice Burger
education: University of Pennsylvania, Master's in computer science
Harvard Business School, half an MBA
founders.background_notes: Per YC company page; tech.eu says he left a Harvard MBA to do the Penn master's.

founders.name: Roman Engeler
education: MSc Robotics, ETH Zurich, Stanford and Imperial (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC launch text says he led product and engineering at two fast growing startups.

exit.reason: YC lists Inactive; no shutdown or acquisition report found.

competitors.name: Patronus AI
competitors.what: Automated LLM evaluation and security platform founded 2023
competitors.funding_then: $3M seed in Sep 2023 per a database listing

technical_complexity.rationale: Training purpose-built judge models and an agent tracing platform is demanding but built on open base models such as Llama 3.1 (per Selene 1 Mini model card).

defensibility.rationale: Many evaluation vendors and open tools exist, and the Selene models were released open source, limiting lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent acquisition found. Foundation labs and observability platforms kept adding evaluation features.

market_need_then: In 2023 teams were shipping LLM features with no standard way to test them, which supported demand for automated evaluation; no revenue figures were found.

branding.domain_note: Uses atla-ai.com rather than a bare .com; the homepage returned 404 when fetched.

identity.logo: A design case study says the original logo resembled a world atlas silhouette and a later version used a 3D globe

branding.brand_signature: Selene, the named evaluator model family
branding.community_and_virality: Selene models reported as downloaded 60,000+ times by YC page; Selene launched on Product Hunt.

brand_strength.rationale: Selene had Product Hunt and Hugging Face presence, but there is no press about the Atla brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Atla raised a $5M seed led by Creandum in December 2023, built the open Selene judge models and later repositioned toward improving AI agents. YC now lists it Inactive, but no source gives a shutdown, a reason or an acquirer, so the cause is not public and no factors are assigned.
notes: Seed confirmed by tech.eu with other outlets in search results (Seedtable, Owler) repeating $5M; no later round found, so coverage is partial. Selene API page still listed in search results, so Inactive status is unconfirmed. Patronus AI source is a database entry dated Sept 2023, a few months after the S23 batch.
